AGENDA
Regular Meeting of the Public Health & Safety Commission
Monday, December 16, 2024 4:00PM
Council Chambers
505 South Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
A copy of the Public Health and Safety Commission meeting packet may be viewed by the public in the City Hall lobby and on the City's webpage at www.encinitasca.gov .
Members of Public Health and Safety Commission
Steven Cesnauskas, Chair

Lauren Andrade, Commissioner

The Encinitas Public Health and Safety Commission welcomes you and encourages your continued interest and involvement in the City's decision-making process.
KNOW YOUR RIGHTS UNDER THE OPEN GOVERNMENT LAWS: Government's duty is to serve the public, reaching its decisions in full view of the public. Commissions, boards, councils and other agencies of the City exist to conduct the people's business. For more information on your rights under the Brown Act and other State laws, visit the city's webpage at www.encinitasca.gov under the heading Resources.
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the Public Health and Safety Commission regarding any item on this agenda received after the posting of the agenda and prior to the meeting will be made available for public inspection in the City Hall lobby during normal business hours.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act/Section 504 Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and Title VI, this agency is an equal opportunity public entity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnic origin, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status or physical or mental disability in employment or the provision of service. If you require special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the Staff Liaison at 760-633-2613 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.
VISUAL MATERIALS FOR PUBLIC HEALTH AND SAFETY COMMISSION MEETINGS
All digital presentation materials must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov at least 2 hours before the meeting (appeal hearing materials are due 7 days in advance). Accepted formats include digital photos, Microsoft Office files, and PDFs. CDs, DVDs, and USB drives will not be accepted. All files must be in PC format and labeled with the corresponding agenda item number. If technical assistance is necessary, IT will be available to presenters from 3:30 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. All presentations are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE:
WRITTEN COMMENTS: To submit written comments, e-mail firesvcs@encinitasca.gov and include the related agenda item in the subject line. Email comments will be provided to the commission members and included in the meeting record. Any writings or documents submitted to a majority of the commission regarding an agenda item, received after the agenda is posted and before the meeting, will also be included as part of the official record.
IN-PERSON COMMENTS: Speaker Requests will be accepted no earlier than 30 minutes before the start of the meeting. Please be aware that the Chair has the authority to reduce equally each speaker’s time to accommodate a larger number of speakers. Speakers are allotted three (3) minutes to address the Commission on any one item. All requests to speak must be submitted before the Commission begins to discuss the item.
